name: Living Stone
description: Recover dense fragments from Ash Golems near Ironhaven.

dialogue.offer: I need five Ash Fragments to reinforce the town gate. Ordinary stone cracks in this heat.
dialogue.in_progress: The Ash Golems beyond our northern road hold the fragments together.
dialogue.ready: Dense, even, and still warm. These will anchor the gate.
dialogue.completed: Ironhaven's gate now stands as firm as the mountain.
